title: Scallions — new app launched
content:
Scallions is a new JeffersonWM app, built in a single session from scratch. The concept started as a simple page — a clean clone of the I Went to City layout, blank with a bottom banner and centered text — but it quickly grew into something with its own identity.

The app is a California-focused seasonal directory. It presents a minimal alphabetized vertical list of fruits, vegetables, and sports seasons. Clicking any item opens a popup with its approximate start and end dates for the year. Nothing more. The design is intentionally sparse: just a list of what is in season right now, rendered in a rotating set of curated typefaces.

The typefaces are pulled dynamically from the platform widget_fonts database and assigned randomly on every page load, so each visit looks slightly different. The seasonal data lives in the same database, making future additions straightforward.

Scallions is live at jeffersonwm.com/scallions.
